title: RBAC — Roles & Permissions
description: RBAC engine ported from superspace: 6 system role presets (owner/admin/manager/staff/client/guest with levels), dot-namespaced permissions with `*` / `feature.*` wildcard matching, pure check helpers (resolvePermissions / hasPermission / roleHasPermission), and props-driven UI primitives — <PermissionGate>, usePermissions, <RoleBadge>, <PermissionMatrix>. Convex template ships a tenant-scoped rbac_roles table + checkPermission / requirePermission helpers + seedSystemRoles. No Clerk. Pair with `user-management` for the members/invites UI.

peers.reason: Permission checks resolve the authed user via getAuthUserId.
